Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: decision-needed.

The store persists project parts and the ticket explicitly asks for a retention policy, either documented retention by design or garbage collection of unreferenced parts. No policy decision or authoritative retention test was identified in the audited source/evidence. This is not safely inferred from incidental save behavior. Choose the recoverability/space trade-off, record it, and then either document bounded retention or implement manifest/journal-aware collection with reopen and rollback coverage.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/platform/FileProjectStore.scala:74
- docs/development/CONSOLIDATION_2026-10-05.md:110

Remaining / next action: Make and record the retention decision; implement/document it with store lifecycle tests.

Disposition: Keep open.
